newsitem.title: CANADA: CIBC sets C$300 mln preferred shr issue.
newsitem.headline: CIBC sets C$300 mln preferred shr issue.

text.p: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce said on Monday that it was filing a prospectus for a C$300 million preferred share issue in the Canadian market.
It said the issue would consist of 12 million non-cumulative class A preferred shares series 15, priced at $25 a share to yield 5.65 per cent.
The preferred shares will be redeemable by CIBC at a declining premium after 7-3/4 years for cash or for common shares at 95 per cent of the market price of the common shares.
CIBC said the shares would also be convertible by the holder into CIBC common shares after 10-3/4 years at 95 per cent of the market price, subject to CIBC's right to redeem for cash.
The offering will be underwritten by a group of investment dealers led by CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc. The expected closing date for the issue is November 1, 1996.
